notes: This is a synthetic, hand-labeled adversarial regression suite for the deterministic baseline.

It includes status/message conflicts, ordinary HTTP 404 traps, ambiguous 400/5xx cases, transport errors, credential failures, mapping failures, webhook failures, and cases where the correct result is unknown/no retry.
A perfect score on this bounded suite is not a claim of universal n8n failure-classification accuracy. Real execution samples and model-assisted comparisons remain future evaluation work.
